own_role: Start-up store commanded_throttle_state.throttle_minimum (0x80aa8c) = word 0x807ce4 (e2m 1048 +6 CTHISATH) + 4; nothing else.
reason: Both analysts agree. ROM 0x10e06 move.w (0x807ce4),d0 / addq.w #4 / move.w d0,(0x80aa8c) / rts; only caller mc68k_applicationMain (jsr 0x28780). CM848 0x17af4 does the same store plus five more resets and the delta filter, so counterpart. Name unique.

own_role: Per primary speed interrupt: with CBDEN = 1 and engine_speed_source_select 0, sums the EPS periods of a cylinder segment from the start tooth (TPU_CH15_PARAM6 low byte, +36 on crank revolution 2), stores a segment every 4 periods and after slot 6 publishes the 7 sums (clamped 0..150000) as CBDSB1-7 and sets CBDSBRF.
reason: Name CONFIRMED (asm 0x1266e-0x1277a read; the only writer of CBDSB1-7 / CBDSBRF; reads the MC68336 TPU parameter word directly, the repository's mc68k_ rule as for mc68k_alignCylinderIndexToCrankRevolution; CM848 0x42bd0 stores TPU-A channel 14 capture differences instead, so counterpart). Dump: ESTTIP 3, ESNOTTCU 34, so 4 periods = 12 teeth = 120 degrees. AMENDED comment only: the four handlers call it unconditionally on every interrupt (jsr 0x19c62 / 0x19f5c / 0x1a6c2 / 0x1a912) and the CBDEN test is inside it, not in the callers.
final_comment: Cylinder balancing speed buffer fill. The four TPU channel 10 primary speed interrupt handlers call it on every interrupt; it works only while cylinder_balance_enable_flag (e2m 823C +34 CBDEN) is 1. The tooth number is the low byte of TPU_CH15_PARAM6 (+36 on the second crank revolution, CMSYFG); at cylinder_balance_start_tooth (CBDST) it restarts the segment. It adds main_engine_position_sensor_period into the segment sum, and every 4 periods (one 120 degree segment with 3 teeth per period in this dump) it stores the sum in cylinder_balance_segment_periods[index]; after slot 6 it copies the 7 sums, clamped to 0..150000, into cylinder_balance_speed_buffer_1-7 (CBDSB1-7), carries slot 6 into slot 0 and sets cylinder_balance_speed_buffer_ready_flag (CBDSBRF). With engine_speed_source_select not 0 it only clears that flag.

own_role: Once per 40-frame cycle (frame 38) with CBDEN: acceleration samples CBDAXB1-6, six-point Fourier terms, stop compensation flag, learned dynamics compensation, trim indexes / magnitudes / increments, trim adjustment and limits of the saved trims, mean removal, and the six per-cylinder offsets 0x80a1ac-0x80a1b6 = FLFLAJCn + trim x CBDATG / 100 in firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4.
reason: Both analysts agree. Full decompile and the asm of 0x127c2-0x12a60 / 0x12e80-0x130e0 checked: Fourier formulas, CBDSCF terms (CBDATG < 100, speed change > CBDDST, no new buffer, engine_state not 3), gain selection by magnitude vs CBDFT, cutout timer reload from CBDDSTM, gates CBDCEN / CBDSCF / CMSYSS / CRSYSS (0x80d0cc / 0x80d0cd = cam and crank sync) / road speed / coolant / IMT. Output mapping cyl1<-0x809246, cyl2<-0x80924e, cyl3<-0x80924a, cyl4<-0x809250, cyl5<-0x809248, cyl6<-0x80924c proves the firing order. Only caller jsr 0x1be60 (case 0x26). No VP44 register or message: cm550_. CM848 hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims is different code (4/6/8 cylinders, filters): counterpart.

own_role: Empty function (rts), called once per 40-frame cycle as the extra task of executive frame 5.
reason: Name CONFIRMED (body 4e75; the only reference is the jsr in case 5 of executiveFrameInterruptHandler; the other 4-byte hits are 33fc move.w opcodes; stub numbers 12-15 are free and follow the cm550_emptyStubFunction10 / 11 precedent). AMENDED comment: the jsr instruction is at 0x1ba2c (0x1ba2e is its operand).
final_comment: Empty function (a single rts). Its one call is the extra task of executive frame 5 (jsr at 0x1ba2c in executiveFrameInterruptHandler, after the six task sets), so it runs once per 40-frame cycle and does nothing. It sits between the cylinder balancing trim calculation and its initializer; an empty body cannot prove a role or a CM848 counterpart.

No VP44 access, so the vp44_ prefix was wrong. CM848 hpcr_cbdInitFilterState sets the event counter / caches and copies its trims: counterpart.

own_role: Percent peak torque x 256 at one speed: 4D steady state fueling at (speed, throttle 400), storage offset removed and clamped 0..5888, minus (friction fueling arg + coolant correction 0x80052c), x 0x6400, saturating divide by (JCMXT0FL - JCFCBK04).
reason: Twin proven: CM848 0x18070 has the same steps in the same order (lookup at y 400, clamp 0..0x1700, subtract friction + coolant correction, x 0x6400, saturating divide by j1939_peak_fueling_tau_0 - j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4) and the same call graph position (called 5 times by the twin parents 0x143b6 / 0x1820c in the order idle, rated, bp3, bp4, bp5). The only difference is data encoding: cm550_subtractAndClampValue also removes the +11776 storage offset of the CM550 4D tables (documented on four_dimensional_fueling_steady_state_lookup) and the lookup takes a record. Shared unprefixed name; the CM848 row changes too.

reason: Twin proven: CM848 0x1811c does the same five lookups of the same table in the same order into the same 10E2 records; callers are the twin parent (bsr 0x143dc / CM848 0x1820c) and the twin start-up initializer (jsr 0x1de4e / CM848 0x1ea94). Shared unprefixed name; the CM848 row changes too.

reason: Both analysts agree on the role. asm 0x14812-0x14870 read; called by cm550_faultFlagScannerAndProcessor when bit 0 of the request word is set (jsr 0x14e3e). CM848 cm848_clearDiagnosticState has the same previously active clear plus the active / OBD branches behind other gates: counterpart. Name unique.

own_role: On entry to CRANKING / REENTRY: crank initial advance CKIITA and its break speed CKIITAES from the intake manifold temperature: low values with an enabled IMT high / low fault or below the low point, high values above the high point, else interpolated.
reason: Name CONFIRMED (asm 0x17baa-0x17ca4; only writer of 0x80d0a8 / 0x80d0b4; second call of cm550_engineModeTransitionHandler, the slot of CM848 0x1bd74 in cm848_processColdStartAdjustment; CM848 has no enable mask test, <= / >= bounds and a slope formula, so counterpart). AMENDED comment: it cited names that do not exist (crank_initial_timing_advance, crank_initial_advace_break_speed, crank_low / high_intake_manifold_temperature); the rows carry range suffixes.
final_comment: Crank initial timing on entry to CRANKING or REENTRY (called by cm550_engineModeTransitionHandler): crank_initial_timing_advance_0_120 (e2m 105E +10 CKIITA) and crank_initial_advace_break_speed_0_1000 (105E +1C CKIITAES) interpolated by intake_manifold_temperature_sensor_state.filtered_value between crank_low_intake_manifold_temperature_50_to_293 (105F +8 CKCDIMTP) and crank_high_intake_manifold_temperature_50_to_293 (105F +6 CKHTIMTP) from the low / high temperature timings (CKCDIMTA / CKHTIMTA) and speeds (CKCDIMES / CKHTIMES). Below the low point, or with the intake manifold temperature high or low fault (bits 13 / 14, set and enabled) it takes the low temperature values; above the high point the high ones. CM848's cm848_calculateCrankInitialAdvanceByIntakeManifoldTemperature uses the fault bits only, <= / >= bounds and a slope formula.

own_role: Looks up the fault derate fuel limit at the five torque curve speeds; with EPTQCG & request flags non-zero clamps each curve fueling down to it, else, when no request above the fault derate bit is set, writes the five values.
reason: Both analysts agree. asm 0x183cc-0x184c4 read; only caller bsr 0x185d6 (0x184c6). CM848 0x507858 tests the clamp mask against cm848_getHighestPriorityBit only: counterpart.

own_role: While EPFLLMSS is 1 sets the fault derate request bit and, as the highest request, the five torque curve speed points (LSG reference less droop term, HSG reference before droop plus droop term for HSG sources 1/2/4/5 capped at 40000 or EPRPP2, EPRPP3-5), then calls 0x183cc; otherwise clears its bit.
reason: Both analysts agree. asm 0x184c6-0x185ee read (LSDPEN = algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal bit 6, /167, (x << 3) x HSDPSLAE / 0x8888). First call of buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload in both firmwares; CM848 0x507a20 also accepts source 12 and caps point 1: counterpart.

own_role: Start-up: fault derate request bit 0x80060c = 1 << EPTQPZ; fault derate curve-points lookup record offset 2 with its axis / value pointers.
reason: Twin proven: CM848 0x507c1c computes 1 << (position & 0x3f) (the 68k lsl.w by a register count uses the count mod 64, the same result) and presets the same lookup offset 2; both are the first of the two closing calls of the shared initializePgn65251EngineConfiguration1Buffer. The pointer stores are the CM550 record convention (initializeHighSpeedGovernorGainSet precedent). Shared unprefixed name.

own_role: Start-up: copies EPSOAE (the last shutdown channel) into 0x80061e and clears 0x80061c, the previous shutdown command that processDiagnosticLimitStatus uses for edge counting and as its shutdown latch.
reason: Role agreed by both analysts (describer cm550_resetEngineProtectionShutdownState). asm: move.w (0x8058ce),(0x80061e) / clr.w (0x80061c) / rts; only caller vp44_engineProtectionSystemInit after cm550_initShutdownLimitVariables. 0x80061e is read only by the consecutive-count compare (0x1927e). Note: 0x80061c also latches the shutdown (while set processDiagnosticLimitStatus skips the channels and holds engine_shutdown_command_flag at 1 until STOPPED), so the name is narrow but not wrong. CM848 0x508de8 does more resets: counterpart.

own_role: Task 2 of the engine protection scheduler: per-channel fueling severities (history-only channels kept out), oil pressure power-up inhibit, ramped filtered severity capped at 256, fault_derate_fuel_limit between the derate curve and the 100 percent fueling, EPFLLMSS.
reason: Name CONFIRMED (case 2 of cm550_engineProtectionMultiStateSlowCycle40Coordinator, the slot of CM848 task 2 cm848_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit, which has one channel and no oil pressure inhibit: counterpart; the only run-time writer of 0x800630 / 0x80d284 besides the init 0x19960 and the disabled path). AMENDED comment: table bit 0x1a0 + n is algorithm_enable_flags_26_cal bit n, the history-only (no derate) enable, not a restart enable; such a channel is not floored by its restart severity and is left out of the maximum.
final_comment: Engine protection fault derate fuel limit, task 2 of cm550_engineProtectionMultiStateSlowCycle40Coordinator. Over the 9 protection channels (configurations 0x807032 + 36n, states 0x80d0dc + 46n, severity records 0x8057c0 + 30n) that are enabled (configuration bit 0) and have their fueling limiting enable (table bit 0x70 + 4n) or their history-only bit (algorithm_enable_flags_26_cal bit n, table bit 0x1a0 + n) set, it takes the fueling severity (the ramped cm550_protectionThresholdCalculationHelper when configuration bit 0x40 is set, else cm550_protectionPercentageCalculator once the channel's fault time passes its configuration time) and stores it in the channel's fueling severity index. A channel that is not history-only gets at least its fueling restart severity index and counts toward the highest severity; a history-only channel keeps its severity for the record but does not derate. While oil pressure fueling limiting is enabled a power-up inhibit forces full severity (0x100) for the oil pressure channel and the maximum until oil_pressure_fault_inhibit_timer (counted while the engine turns, reset at 0 rpm) reaches its limit. engine_protection_fueling_severity_filtered moves toward the maximum by the ramp rate and is capped at 256; fault_derate_fuel_limit is fuel_demand_maximum at 0, else the fault derate curve at engine_rpm_primary plus (256 - severity) x (throttle_100_fueling - curve) / 256; fault_derate_active_flag = severity above 0. CM848's cm848_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit runs in the same task slot with one channel and no oil pressure inhibit.

own_role: Configuration 1 step 1: TPU channel 10 primary speed set-up and pulse period table fill, installing the Mode1 handler 0x19e90.
reason: Both analysts agree. Disassembly diff with 0x1999c: identical except the handler store (0x19e90 vs 0x19acc) and branch targets; called from case 1 of cm550_initializeEnginePositionSignalInputs (jsr 0x1716e). Dump: configuration 1, 0x808f04 = 0x19e90. Writes TPU registers directly: mc68k_.

reason: Body 4e75; only reference jsr 0x1717a (case 1, third call); the configuration 0 / 2 / 3 third steps are empty too. Stub number follows the cm550_emptyStubFunction precedent; unique.

own_role: EPS main / backup phase check for a backup period: skipped while the backup sync-pulse result 0x80aa18 is set; with the main lost counter at 0 marks the backup in phase; with matching tooth counters stores ESPHDF and counts out-of-phase teeth into ESMNIPER / ESBUIPER.

No absolute, relative or pointer reference in the ROM or either RAM dump (checked), as the plate says; medium confidence accepted because the code itself fixes the role.

reason: Name CONFIRMED (diff with 0x1999c: handler 0x1a52c, parameter 1 from 0x807ec8 / ESPECM01, otherwise the same; case 2 jsr 0x17196). AMENDED comment: 'period_meas_per_cam_number_of_primary_speed_pulse_periods' is not a row name (the row is ..._mea_0_255), and both set-ups use ESPECY01 for the per-cylinder pointer (not a difference).
final_comment: Step 1 of engine_position_signal_configuration 2 in cm550_initializeEnginePositionSignalInputs: the same TPU channel 10 primary speed set-up and pulse period table fill as the mode 0 / 1 set-ups, but it installs mc68k_tpuChannel10PrimarySpeedInterruptHandlerMode2 (0x808f04 = 0x1a52c) and sets parameter 1 = (0x807ec8 / period_meas_per_cam_number_of_primary_speed_pulse_periods_mea_0_255 (ESPECM01)) << 8 instead of primary_speed_sensor_teeth_per_period_measurement << 8; like them, the per-cylinder pointer uses ESPECY01.

own_role: Configuration 2 step 2: TPU channel 0 as function 9 (missing tooth input) with parameter 0 = 4, channel 15 parameter 6 seeded 0xc000, priority 2 and the handler 0x1a6e8, then mc68k_initializeSpeedMeasurementMode0.
reason: Name CONFIRMED (diff with mode 1's 0x19dd0: parameter 0 4 vs 7, no parameter 2 / 4-6 writes, TPU_CH15_PARAM6 = 0xc000, priority 2 vs 1, handler 0x1a6e8 vs 0x19f82; case 2 jsr 0x1719c). AMENDED comment: 'pmm_num_of_teeth' is not a row name, and 0xc000 is not proven to mean 'no sync error': the handler 0x1a6e8 turns error type 0xc0 into sync state 0 ('no sync') and every other type into 2 ('lost sync').
final_comment: Step 2 of engine_position_signal_configuration 2 in cm550_initializeEnginePositionSignalInputs: disables TPU channel 0, sets it to function 9 (the missing tooth period measurement) with parameter 0 = 4, parameter 1 = 0x100 + pmm_num_of_teeth_correct_tooth_count_at_missing_tooth_0_255 (ESNOTTCU), parameter 3 = pmm_ratio_tooth_spacing_at_which_missing_tooth_is_found_0_1_9921875 << 8 | tooth_count_at_which_missing_tooth_not_detct_err_0_255, seeds TPU_CH15_PARAM6 with 0xc000 (error type 0xc0, which the handler 0x1a6e8 turns into cam / crank sync state 0 'no sync', any other type giving 2 'lost sync'), HSQR 3, HSRR 1, priority 2, the channel 0 handler 0x808edc = 0x1a6e8 (it reads the PMM error type CKSYERTY and tooth CKSYERTT from channel 15 parameter 6) and the interrupt enable, then calls mc68k_initializeSpeedMeasurementMode0. Mode 1 uses mc68k_initializeTpuChannel0MissingToothInput (parameter 0 = 7, handler 0x19f82).

Body jsr 0x34674 / rts, the same bytes as configuration 0's step 2 at 0x19ac2; only reference jsr 0x171b0; 0x34674 acts only for configurations 0 and 1. own_role: Cam sync type 0 set-up of TPU channel 1: fills the backup pulse period table and, with ESSXSNEN bit 3, makes channel 1 a period input (function 0xd, parameter 0 = 0xb, HSQR / HSRR 3, priority 2) with the handler 0x1b30a.
reason: Both analysts agree on the role (describer ...BackupSpeedInputIfEnabled). Dispatcher 0x1839a: EPCMSYTY 0 -> jsr 0x1b1ea (dump 0). Diff with type 1's 0x1ae22: enable-bit gate, parameter 0 0xb vs 0x4f, HSQR 3, handler 0x1b30a (period capture) vs 0x1af32 (cylinder identification pulse width in teeth), so 'Period' discriminates. own_role: Channel 1 ISR for cam sync type 0: with ESSXSNEN bit 3 reloads the backup lost counter, captures the backup period from parameters 4-5, sets CMSYRSFG, clears the cam sync fault, seeds the backup table and average; then resets the channel 0 speed measurement and clears its interrupt flag (RTE).
reason: Name CONFIRMED (asm 0x1b30a-0x1b398; installed at 0x1b28e; the only channel 1 handler that captures the period). AMENDED comment: it clears only parameter 4 (clr.w 0xffff18), the second copy goes to ESPLAVBU (0x80ccfc, average pulse period backup), not to 'the EPS backup period' (that is 0x80d04e, where the capture is stored first), and the cited 'backup_lost_counter' is not a row name.
final_comment: TPU channel 1 interrupt handler installed by mc68k_initializeTpuChannel1BackupSpeedPeriodInput (cam sync type 0; it ends in RTE). With engine_speed_sensor_enable_flags bit 3 set it reloads backup_lost_counter_timeout_counter_for_secondary_speed_inp_0_10000 (ESTMCU02) from pulse_period_timeout_backup, takes the period from channel 1 parameters 4-5 into eps_period_backup_time_between_the_two_most_recent_eps_200_16777216 (ESIPBKPE) and clears parameter 4, sets cam_cycle_reset_flag (e2m 11A8 +2, EPS pulse seen), clears the cam sync fault (status word 2 bit 0x800) when its first-occurrence latch is clear (interrupts masked) and copies the period into the first entry of the backup pulse period table (ESPSTB02) and into average_pulse_period_backup_time_period_over_1_cyl_of_secondary_2_32 (ESPLAVBU); otherwise it only clears parameter 4. Then it calls mc68k_resetSpeedMeasurementMode0 and the empty hook 0xc87e and clears its interrupt status bit.

own_role: Channel 1 ISR for cam sync type 2: only mc68k_resetSpeedMeasurementMode0, the empty hook 0xc87e and the CISR bit 1 clear (RTE).
reason: Both analysts agree on the body (describer ...InterruptHandlerCamSyncType2). asm 0x1b4b2-0x1b4ce; installed by 0x1b39a (move.l #0x1b4b2,(0x808ee0) at 0x1b48e, the only pointer); 0xc87e is a bare rts. The name states its only work.

own_role: Start-up set-up of the double pulsing fueling mapping lookup and the steady state / transient 4D injection timing lookups (pointers, offsets 2).
reason: Both analysts agree. The three records are used only by cm550_fuelDemandTableBlendCalculator; only caller mc68k_applicationMain. CM848 0x1ea6c presets only the two timing caches: counterpart.

reason: Both analysts agree. asm 0x1c824-0x1c89e; only caller bsr 0x1c8ec. CM848 0x21c3c rebuilds the bit and only floors point 1: counterpart.

own_role: Throttle 100 requester (every 100 ms): builds its request bit once, and without programmable power sets the bit, the speed points and the 100 percent throttle fuelings at the five points (clamp with FSMXTHCG, else set as highest request); with programmable power clears its bit.
reason: Both analysts agree. asm 0x1c8a0-0x1c9d0; caller cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase14. CM848 0x21cd4 also builds the reference fuelings and tests the highest bit: counterpart.

own_role: Frame 15 (before the protection coordinator): with engine protection and fuel temperature fueling or rpm limiting enabled, EPFLTP = converted VP44 pump temperature (EPFTFG 0), the default EPFLTPDF while fault 295 is set, or the ECM sensor value (EPFTFG not 0).
reason: Name CONFIRMED: it is the engine protection input selector; the pump value is reached only through the converter, so cm550_ (the describer's vp44_ is not needed). asm 0x1cad6-0x1cb3a read; caller frame 15 of executiveFrameInterruptHandler right before cm550_engineProtectionMultiStateSlowCycle40Coordinator. AMENDED comment: 'default_value_for_vp44_fuel_temperature_when_sensor_is_fail' is not a row name (the row is ..._40_to_300) and the ECM value is fuel_temperature_sensor_state.filtered_value.
final_comment: Fuel temperature input of engine protection (executive frame 15, once per 200 ms, before cm550_engineProtectionMultiStateSlowCycle40Coordinator). While engine_protection_enable and the fuel temperature fueling or rpm limiting enable are set it writes engine_protection_fuel_temperature (e2m 81FA +0 EPFLTP): with engine_protection_fuel_temperature_source (81F9 +2 EPFTFG) 0 the VP44 pump's fuel temperature converted by vp44_convertPumpFuelTemperatureToSensorScale, or default_value_for_vp44_fuel_temperature_when_sensor_is_fail_40_to_300 (EPFLTPDF) while fault bit 295 (status word 18 bit 7) is set; otherwise the ECM fuel temperature sensor's fuel_temperature_sensor_state.filtered_value (ADFLTPFT). Not VP44 handling itself, so cm550_.

own_role: Start-up: EPFLTP = ADDFFLTP (fuel_temperature_sensor_config.default_value).
reason: Both analysts agree. move.w (0x806afc),(0x80a254) / rts; only caller mc68k_applicationMain. No VP44 access: the vp44_ prefix was wrong.

own_role: Returns in d0 the VP44 pump fuel temperature FLFLTP (1/16 degF signed) + 800, limited 0..5600, shifted left 3 = (T + 50) x 128, the EPFLTP scale.
reason: Both analysts agree on the role (describer vp44_convertPumpFuelTemperature). asm 0x1cb48-0x1cb74; only caller jsr 0x1cb26, which stores d0. It converts the pump's own reported value, so vp44_ fits. (Its function_definitions row could declare a word return; none was proposed.)

own_role: Start-up set-up of the low horsepower curve lookup (4D steady state fueling, y input fixed at 400) and the cold temperature fuel increment lookup of cm550_calculateThrottle100Fuelings.
reason: Both analysts agree. Both records are used only by cm550_calculateThrottle100Fuelings; caller cm550_masterSubsystemInit. CM848 0x1f300 presets one cache only: counterpart.

own_role: Start-up: ZILMES 0x80d686 and the word 0x80def0 = maximum_rated_engine_speed_0_5000 (no injector fault speed derate).
reason: Name CONFIRMED (move.w (0x803f40) into 0x80d686 and 0x80def0; only caller mc68k_applicationMain; e2m 10C4 +0 ZILMES in group 0x21 INJLIMIT). AMENDED comment: 'maximum_rated_engine_speed' is not a row name (the row is ..._0_5000), and the 10C3 calibration and ZILMES do have parameter-table entries (0x359b4-0x359c0), only no code reference.
final_comment: Start-up initializer (mc68k_applicationMain) of the injector fault speed derate (e2m group 0x21 'INJECTOR FAULT SPEED DERATE GROUP'): injector_fault_engine_speed_limit (e2m 10C4 +0 ZILMES 'output engine speed limit going to HSG reference speed algorithm') and the word 0x80def0 = maximum_rated_engine_speed_0_5000, no derate. The derate itself and every reader of these words lie outside the dumped ROM (no code reference to ZILMES or to the 10C3 calibration 0x808152-0x808156 in it, only parameter table entries). CM848 has no such feature.

own_role: Start-up: sets the 4D steady state and transient fueling lookups (offsets 2 / 2), the friction fuel by speed and coolant correction lookups (offset 2), then calls calculateJ1939FrictionLoadFuelingAtBreakpoints.
reason: Twin proven: CM848 0x1ea94 asm stores 2 into the steady state pair, the transient pair, the friction offset (0x40aef8) and the coolant correction offset (0x40aefa) in the same order, then bl 0x1811c (the twin of 0x14348); both are start-up steps of applicationMain (CM550 jsr 0x2886a, CM848 cpp line 59502). CM550 also stores the record pointers (record convention). The CM848 name cm848_initFaultSeverityTables is wrong; shared unprefixed name.

own_role: 4D fueling (5DFL): steady state and transient tables at (engine_rpm_primary, commanded throttle) kept between their 0 / 100 percent curves, blended by FLINML (Q14), plus 5DFLAJ, at least fuel_demand_minimum, at most the one-shot 5DIRMXFL which it reloads with 5888.
reason: Both analysts agree. Decompile checked against the asm landmarks; caller cm550_diagnostic_parameter_handler stores it in 0x80d33e. CM848 0x1ec70 has the same structure but the filtered throttle and speed and no 5DFLAJ step, so counterpart, not twin.

own_role: Start-up: FLINML (0x80d340) = 0x4000.
reason: Both analysts agree. move.w #0x4000,(0x80d340) / rts; only caller mc68k_applicationMain. CM848 0x1ef30 also sets the commanded throttle filter: counterpart.

own_role: J1922 engine control (override) request from J1708 MID 74: length check by mode, ignored-request / source table checks, sets the override mode, network type 0, source 74 and control device 1 (TRANS), then the speed / torque / limit request and the retarder, high idle and driveline bits.
reason: Role agreed by both analysts (describer cm550_processJ1922TransmissionEngineControlRequest). Jump table 0x163e8 (MIDs 74-81, J1922 range 69-86 with algorithm flag 0x803caa bit 2): 74 -> 0x1f4e8 only. The source number is a valid discriminator; the code also records the sender as engine_control_device_indicator 1 = TRANS (e2m JCEGCOID), the MID 79 handler 0x1f8bc as 2 = ABS, so a 'Transmission' name would also be supported. Plate checked against the decompile (lengths 3 / 5 / 4 / 5, timeouts, formulas).

own_role: On entry to CRANKING / REENTRY: crank_initial_advance and crank_initial_advance_break_speed from the intake manifold temperature (low values with an IMT error or at / below the low point, high values at / above the high point, else interpolated).
reason: The body writes only crank_initial_advance / crank_initial_advance_break_speed (their only writer) from the 105F crank manifold temperature records; caller cm848_processColdStartAdjustment between the cold start temperature table and the rpm limit. The old name calculateIntakeAirAdjustment says nothing of the crank timing. New name unique in both firmwares. Its old name is cited in one other CM848 function_renames comment (follow-up).

own_role: Returns the 4D fueling: steady state / transient grids at the filtered speed and commanded_throttle_filtered, each kept between its 0 / 100 percent curves without programmable power, blended by the interpolation factor, at least fuel_demand_minimum, at most the one-shot user maximum (reloaded with 5888).
reason: Its result is stored in four_dimensional_fueling (e2m 1053 +0) by cm848_updateFourDimensionalFueling; it is a fueling demand, not a limit. Counterpart of CM550 0x1de58 (no 5DFLAJ increment, other inputs). New name unique. The old name is cited in 3 function_renames and 4 global_variables comments of CM848 (follow-up).
